meta.name: webapp-testing
meta.description: Toolkit for interacting with and testing local web applications using Playwright. Supports verifying frontend functionality, debugging UI behavior, capturing browser screenshots, and viewing browser logs.

copy.tagline: 用 Playwright 测试本地 Web 应用的前端功能与 UI 行为
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化测试本地 Web 应用的前端功能与界面
copy.tagline_en: Test local web apps with Playwright for frontend functionality and UI behavior
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate testing of local web apps' frontend and UI

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以编写并运行 Playwright 脚本，自动测试本地网页应用，包括检查前端功能、调试界面、截图和查看浏览器日志。
howto.when: 当用户要求测试本地运行的网页应用，或需要自动化操作浏览器时触发。

say.text: 帮我测试本地运行的 React 应用，检查按钮点击是否正常。
say.note: Claude 会编写 Playwright 脚本并执行测试。

say.text: 给当前页面截图并保存到 /tmp。
say.note: Claude 会使用 Playwright 截图。

say.text: 查看这个网页的控制台日志。
say.note: Claude 会捕获并返回浏览器日志。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can write and run Playwright scripts to automatically test local web applications, including verifying frontend functionality, debugging UI behavior, capturing screenshots, and viewing browser logs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to test a locally running web application or needs to automate browser interactions.

say_en.text: Test my local React app and check if button clicks work.
say_en.note: Claude will write and execute a Playwright script.

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of the current page and save it to /tmp.
say_en.note: Claude will use Playwright to capture the screenshot.

say_en.text: Show me the console logs of this webpage.
say_en.note: Claude will capture and return browser logs.
